Definition: Jotham, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jotham is named 24 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Judges 9:5; 2 Kings 15:5; 1 Chronicles 2:47. In Judges 9:5 we read, "And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 2:47 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Jotham is never just a name, and I believe a real life stands behind it. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
RelatedPeople: Jotham, Son of Gideon; Jotham, King of Judah; Jotham, Son of Jahdai
